/* 영업일관리 (8030) */ /* AdminBusinessDayMapper.selectBusinessDayList */ SELECT A.DATES AS BAS_DT, A.WEEK AS WKD_CD, NVL(B.HLDY_DSCD, CASE WHEN A.WEEK = '6' THEN '4' WHEN A.WEEK = '0' THEN '5' ELSE '0' END) AS HLDY_DSCD, B.HLDY_TXT FROM( SELECT TO_CHAR((MAKE_DATES + DAY - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') DATES, DECODE(week, '1', '0', '2', '1', '3', '2', '4', '3', '5', '4', '6', '5', '7', '6') WEEK FROM( SELECT LEVEL DAY, TO_DATE(#{hldyYear} || #{hldyMonth} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD') MAKE_DATES, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{hldyYear} || #{hldyMonth}, 'YYYYMM')+ LEVEL - 1, 'D') WEEK FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_CHAR(last_day(TO_DATE(#{hldyYear}||#{hldyMonth},'YYYYMM')), 'DD')) ) A, -- BASDT 20191212 -- WKD_CD 일월화수목금토 0123456 ( SELECT * FROM CSPD118TM WHERE BAS_DT LIKE #{hldyYear} || #{hldyMonth} || '%' ORDER BY BAS_DT ASC) B
WHERE A.DATES = B.BAS_DT(+)
